entries.summary: Phase 1 auth-hardening deployed (H1+H2). H1: Sanctum bearer-token expiration enabled fail-closed (max(1,(int) env('SANCTUM_EXPIRATION_MINUTES',1440)) in config/sanctum.php) + daily sanctum:prune-expired --hours=24 schedule in routes/console.php. H2: named rate limiters 'login' (5/min per email|ip + 20/min per IP, is_string guard prevents array-input 500s inside the limiter) and 'register' (5/min per IP) in AppServiceProvider; throttle:login / throttle:register attached to the two public auth routes (exactly-one-argument named form).
